tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the image, video and audio models with what each accepts (tasks, aspect ratios, resolutions, duration range, modes) and its price in credits. Call this before generate_media; use the exact ids and values it returns.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Full parameter details and pricing for one media model.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Approximate credits for a media generation from the live price list. The exact amount is held when you call generate_media; pass maxCredits there to make it a hard ceiling.

tools.name: generate_media
tools.description: Start a generation. SPENDS CREDITS from the wallet (held now, settled to the actual cost when the job ends; refunded if it fails). Returns a taskId immediately - follow it with get_task (waitSeconds) until completed. Use only the user's own prompt text. For image-to-video etc. upload the source firs

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Status, progress and result of a job started with generate_media. With waitSeconds it waits for completion. resultUrl is a time-limited link - download or use it promptly. Polling also settles the wallet when the job ends.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Stop a job that is still processing and refund its hold. Requires a "generate" key.

tools.name: retry_task
tools.description: Re-run a failed or cancelled job as a new job. SPENDS CREDITS again (a fresh hold). Requires a "generate" key.

tools.name: upload_source_media
tools.description: Upload an image, video or audio file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV, MP3, WAV) to use as sourceImageUrl in generate_media. Send the bytes as base64 (or a local filePath when this server runs locally). Requires a "generate" key.

tools.name: list_chat_models
tools.description: The text/chat models available to chat, with the default and whether each is currently available.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send one chat turn to a TurboMax text model and return its reply. SPENDS CREDITS (held, then settled to actual usage). Stateless: send the whole conversation in messages, or just message for a single question. Requires a "generate" key.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Credit balance, credits-per-dollar, today's usage against the account limits, and recent ledger entries.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: The account's generation history, newest first, with status, cost and result links.

tools.name: browse_gallery
tools.description: Work other users chose to publish, with the prompt and model used. Public; anonymous.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_chat_models · Private data: generate_media, get_task, upload_source_media, get_wallet · Public sink: generate_media, upload_source_media, chat, browse_gallery · Destructive: retry_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_chat_models · Private data: generate_media, get_task, upload_source_media, get_wallet · Public sink: generate_media, upload_source_media, chat, browse_gallery · Destructive: retry_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
